title.zh: 【Fireblocks 与支付服务商 Euronet 扩大合作，推出稳定币卡发行服务】
title.en: 【Fireblocks 与支付服务商 Euronet 扩大合作，推出稳定币卡发行服务】

current_state.zh: Fireblocks expanded its partnership with Euronet to let banks and fintechs issue white-label stablecoin cards using Fireblocks embedded wallets and Euronet's Ren/CoreCard issuance platforms.
current_state.en: Fireblocks expanded its partnership with Euronet to let banks and fintechs issue white-label stablecoin cards using Fireblocks embedded wallets and Euronet's Ren/CoreCard issuance platforms.
